item.title: 'Sweden is my children's country': Health professionals ordered to leave after years of work
item.description: Zahra Kazemipour and Afshad Joubeh, both assistant nurses, are due to be deported from Sweden along with their two children after a government decision to abolish the rule which allowed them to stay in the country.

item.title: The best places to visit in Sweden each season throughout 2026
item.description: Spring, summer, autumn or winter – the changing seasons and geography of a country that covers as many latitudes as Sweden means that the time of the year you visit can have a huge impact on your experience.

item.title: A guide to how to dress for the cold weather like a Swede
item.description: Dress warm for the cold season... but how can we do it like the Swedes do? Fear not, here's our handy guide.

item.title: Today in Sweden: A roundup of the latest news on Wednesday
item.description: Extremely heavy snowfall on north west coast, property market continues to build up steam, and other news from Sweden on Wednesday.

item.title: LISTED: All the new laws coming into force in Sweden at the start of 2026
item.description: Stricter rules on Swedish for Immigrants (SFI), study grants for Ukrainians, and an electric car subsidy. Here's our complete list of all the new laws coming into force in Sweden at the start of 2026.

item.title: 'Avoid travel if you can': More warnings issued as snow hits western Sweden
item.description: Large amounts of snow have fallen in western Sweden, including Gothenburg, and Swedish weather agency SMHI has issued a number of weather warnings as more is expected to fall throughout Wednesday.

item.title: Europe faces transport chaos as deadly cold snap persists
item.description: Snow, ice and high winds brought transport chaos to swathes of Europe for a third day on Wednesday, with hundreds of flights cancelled and passengers stranded.

item.title: Deportations spark pushback against Swedish migration reforms
item.description: Opposition in Sweden against the government's tighter migration laws is starting to build steam, as ordinary Swedes witness their neighbours, children's schoolmates, and local health workers being ordered to leave the country, despite being employed and well-integrated.

item.title: Swedish word of the day: isdygn
item.description: Today’s word of the day is isdygn, a climatological compound word which describes a full day of freezing temperatures.

item.title: What we know so far about Sweden’s newest suspected spy scandal
item.description: A man in his 30s was arrested in Stockholm on Sunday on suspicion of espionage. Here’s what we know about the case so far.
